A '''battle''' took place on a [[Unidentified Outer Rim planet (Clone Wars)|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==The battle==
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatist's]] fleet arrived in orbit of the planet and launched [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to attack the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]. The Republic forces defeated the fighters but later a Separatist frigate joined the battle and managed to damage the Star Destroyer. Despite this, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems's]] fleet was destroyed.
